leadText: Ray of Light!! Through the Crack in the Sky! (Japanese: 斜光！！空の裂け目から…！ Rays of Light!! From the Crack in the Sky...!) is the 31st chapter of the of the Pokémon Adventures manga.
plainText:
Ray of Light!! Through the Crack in the Sky! (Japanese: 斜光！！空の裂け目から…！ Rays of Light!! From the Crack in the Sky...!) is the 31st chapter of the of the Pokémon Adventures manga.

==Plot==
 
==Major events==
Lillie learns from Mina that her father is still alive.
Lusamine chases after , forcing , , and Phyco to follow after them.
Faba learns an Ultra Wormhole opened above Mount Lanakila and enlists Plumeria to help deal with Lusamine.
With encouragement from Gladion, Lillie changes her clothes and goes with Sina, Dexio, and Samson Oak to meet Lusamine.
The enter the wormhole and go into the Reassembly Unit to become their Complete Forme.
Lusamine is defeated by Necrozma.
Moon tries capturing again, but is blinded by a bright light, causing her to misfire.
Sun is knocked into the wormhole, sending him falling towards Mount Lanakila.
